nurse.text: Blessings. This is the Glastonbury Sanctuary. We do scones, crystals and creature care, in that order. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Right. Hold this rose quartz, it'll keep you calm. It also keeps the door open.
All done. They've had the rest. You've had the crystal. Fair trade.
The Ark terminal. It hums. We think that's the ley lines. The engineers think it's the fridge.

else.text: Peace and light. And a biscuit, if you're passing.
